Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

trail objects.", "output": "Team, here is our operational architecture and cross-region replication plan for the enterprise object storage gateway. Please inspect file reference @services/storage/replicator.go and review @infra/terraform/s3_buckets.tf in our workspace. The replication service manages asynchronous object synchronization across primary bucket us-east-1 and secondary replica bucket eu-west-1. In @infra/terraform/s3_buckets.tf, ensure that bucket versioning is enabled and cross-region replication rules specify KMS key identifiers for envelope encryption. The worker pool in @services/storage/replicator.go initializes 32 concurrent multipart upload workers streaming objects larger than 100 MB in parallel 5 MB chunks. Furthermore, object metadata validation in @metadata_validator.go must verify SHA-256 checksums before acknowledging successful replication. In addition, replication dead-letter queues in @replication_dlq.tf must capture failed replication events retrying transient S3 rate limit errors using exponential backoff up to 5 attempts.

Site reliability engineers must monitor replication latency on Datadog, keeping p95 replication delay below 60 seconds for objects up to 1 GB. If an object replication fails due to bucket permission errors, the worker must raise an immediate critical alert to the storage operations PagerDuty rotation. The cloud financial operations lead requires configuring S3 lifecycle rules in @lifecycle.tf transitioning replicated objects to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 90 days. Audit logging in @replication_audit.go must record source bucket, destination bucket, object size, and replication duration to CloudWatch Logs. Bandwidth throttling in @rate_limiter.go must cap cross-region replication throughput at 10 Gbps during peak business hours to prevent saturating Direct Connect links. The storage engineering manager requires automated end-to-end integration tests streaming 50,000 mock customer files verifying zero byte corruptions before production promotion. Event notification consumers in @sqs_consumer.go must poll object creation events from AWS SQS with maximum batch size of 10 messages. Disaster recovery failover scripts in @failover_s3.sh must automate DNS routing updates switching application read traffic to the secondary bucket within 2 minutes.

The Chief Information Security Officer mandates that all replicated objects enforce bucket policies blocking public access and requiring TLS version 1.3. In addition, object locking configurations in @object_lock.tf must enforce legal hold and compliance mode retention for 7 years on financial transaction documents. The infrastructure platform director requires verified disaster recovery tabletop exercises restoring full bucket metadata from cross-region replicas before release. CORS policies in @storage_cors.tf must restrict allowed origins to internal application domains. Bucket tagging automation in @tagger.go must apply cost center and environment tags to every uploaded object payload. TLS session parameters in @tls_config.go must disable legacy TLS versions, enforcing cipher suites with forward secrecy. Network connection pooling in @http_client.go must maintain 500 persistent TCP connections per destination endpoint with keep-alive probes sent every 15 seconds. Storage metrics exporters in @metrics_exporter.go must export ingress bytes, egress bytes, and active transfer worker counts to Prometheus every 10 seconds.

Multipart upload cleanup jobs in @cleanup_cron.sh must abort orphaned multipart upload parts older than 7 days saving cloud storage costs. Payload integrity checkers in @crc_validator.go must compute 64-bit CRC checksums in streaming chunks during socket transmission. Edge caching layers in @cloudfront_distro.tf must cache static public read assets with 1-hour time-to-live expiration at edge locations. Access log analyzers in @access_log_parser.py must parse raw S3 server access logs flagging anomalous download spikes exceeding 1 TB per hour. The enterprise compliance officer requires annual third-party security audits verifying SOC 2 Type II compliance across all replicated object storage facilities. Bucket inventory reports in @inventory_config.tf must generate weekly ORC format inventory summaries to track object version distributions. Object label verification in @attribute_validator.go must reject PUT requests missing mandatory department and cost center tags. Cross-region data transfer alarms in @transfer_alarm.tf must notify the cloud infrastructure team if monthly cross-region data egress exceeds 50 TB.

Multipart upload concurrency limits in @upload_pool.go must throttle background uploads to prevent starvations on interactive API requests. Server-side encryption key rotation in @kms_rotator.tf must automatically rotate customer managed KMS keys every 365 days. The lead storage systems architect mandates running continuous disaster recovery failover simulations to prove recovery time objectives below 15 minutes. Bandwidth allocation metrics in @network_throttle.tf must reserve 20% of link capacity for critical database replication streams. Server access logging in @access_logging.tf must partition access log buckets by year, month, and day for efficient Athena queries. Storage quota enforcement in @quota_manager.go must prevent buckets from exceeding 100 PB without executive approval. Site reliability engineers must audit bucket CORS rules every 30 days ensuring compliance with enterprise security requirements. Object retention lock periods must strictly prevent premature deletion of financial audit trail objects."}]
